exposure: knowledge about PPD signs and symptoms
cohort: The study included 250 postnatal women attending postnatal clinics at three selected hospitals in Kumasi, Ghana.
finding: The overall prevalence of postpartum depression was 14%, with maternal age, postpartum blues, mode of delivery, partners' support, and perceived partners' violence/abuse identified as significant predictors.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with postpartum depression (P = 0.001).
